reviewScope: Independent read-only adjudication of seven bounded cases from the completed actual Unity snapshots, attempts, pending history and exact-source standalone compiler review. No new LLM requests or Unity execution.

boundedManualAssessment.interpretation: Seven bounded cases are accepted under manual semantic reading. This is a separate adjudication, not an edited automated result, new experiment or general reliability estimate.

cases.qualification: An extra camera and white Point were created in addition to create_world defaults. The prompt did not specify an exact camera count. Framing, camera precedence and artistic quality were not assessed.
This verifies actual partial terrain update and preserved decoration identities, not all visual effects of terrain regeneration.

cases.qualification: Scoped knowledge and components were inspected. A new runtime NPC conversation was not performed.

Exact pending code reviewed and compiled as a standalone library only. No Unity import, attach, execution or new lifecycle 11/11 was run for RotatorY.

rawReasons: The explanation did not describe the actual terrain.
evidence.exactResponse: Выбранная модель: pollinations:openai-fast. В сцене находятся 98 объектов, включая один NPC Игнат (страж), 3 дома, 12 деревьев, 4 камня, 5 источников света (3 оранжевых точечных, 1 точечный, 1 солнце), 2 камеры, 1 мир, 1 террейн и группа WorldWeaverGenerated. Все объекты принадлежат проекту и находятся в пределах заданных координат.

cases.qualification: The runner omits the Russian transliteration террейн from its terrain word list; the response explicitly says 1 террейн and gives matching object counts. This is a lexical false-negative for the bounded description criterion. The extra universal coordinate sentence is not established by these checks.

extraClaimReview.text: Все объекты принадлежат проекту и находятся в пределах заданных координат.

ownershipRecorded.interpretation: All captured scene objects are marked owned; this does not assert ownership of every project asset.

extraClaimReview.coordinateClaim: No explicit universal coordinate bound was defined for every object. This sentence is unproven. If interpreted as all objects inside the 160x160 Terrain footprint, it is false: the overview camera is outside that footprint.

limitations: Dependent tasks in a single conversation are not independent samples.
Manual acceptance does not certify every explanation sentence, all geometry, artistic quality or GUI usability.
Case4 establishes goal/preset configuration, not semantic route reachability.
Case6 has only standalone mcs validation in this review; no Unity import, attach or execution is claimed.
The raw automated 6/7 and its failure reason remain unchanged; the runner source and criterion were not modified.
